caption: The drawing depicts a metal oil lamp with a curved handle extending upwards from one side of the main body, which is oval in shape with a flat surface on top and a small round receptacle on the left side for holding oil or a wick. A pointed, hook-like suspension device is attached at the top center, connected with two small interlinked metal rings. The lamp is rendered in dark shades of gray and black, showing metallic texture and highlights. The lamp sits inside a large squared frame on a plain background. To the upper left and right inside the main square, there are two smaller inset sketches in thin black lines. The left inset shows a simplified front view of the lamp handle and hanger, while the right inset shows a top-down schematic view of the lamp’s shape and structure. The lamp occupies the central area, with the hook extending upwards towards the top edge of the drawing.
title: Betty Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
